name: Escape
overview: The biblical narrative in Genesis reveals that after sin entered the world, Adam and Eve attempted to escape the immediate presence of God by hiding, driven by fear and shame due to their nakedness. Their efforts to cover themselves and conceal their disobedience illustrate humanity's futile attempt to evade God's judgment and holiness. Similarly, Cain's denial and evasion when confronted by God about his brother Abel further demonstrate that no one can truly escape God's righteous inquiry and accountability.
